question: For the original frozen E16 k1,k2,K triangle labels at the original E17A redshift math nodes, what individual-halo spatial radii and NFW form factors follow CONDITIONALLY from the published Dutton & Maccio (2014) relaxed DM-only Planck 2013 population mass-concentration fit, for declared literature pivot/decase mass QA anchors, without fitting actual LRG/ELG masses, mixing cosmologies unacknowledged, or inventing a halo mass-assembly history?
science_scope: This stage calibrates the POPULATION median concentration c200c(M200c,z), the 200-critical radius and conditional NFW mass/potential spatial shape. Equal-mass snapshots at three z nodes are NOT tracking the same halo, NOT a mass-accretion history, and NOT a measured high-z HOD or a valid combined neutrino+halo dynamical source.

external_primary_literature.citation: Dutton & Maccio, Cold dark matter haloes in the Planck era, MNRAS 441 (2014) 3359, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stu742; equations (7),(10),(11), Table 1 and section 4.1
external_primary_literature.simulation: Relaxed CDM-only Planck-2013 halos, NFW c200c, 200 times CRITICAL density, NOT virial cvir and NOT Einasto. Published Planck simulation Omega_m=.3175,h=.671,sigma8=.8344,n_s=.9624,Omega_b=.0490. The original CLASS E17A source has h=.6736 and massive neutrinos .06 eV, so this conditional external prior is NOT an exact cosmology match to the source CLASS run.
external_primary_literature.published_calibration: log10 c200c = a(z) + b(z) log10(M200c/[1e12 h_DM^-1 Msun]), a(z)=0.520+(0.905-0.520) exp[-0.617 z^1.21], b(z)=-0.101+0.026 z. Validated by authors for halo mass/redshift within simulations; use only mass anchors 1e12 and 1e13 h_DM^-1 Msun and z=.945,.95,.955.
external_primary_literature.scatter_scope: Paper reports roughly log-normal 0.11 dex intrinsic c concentration scatter around z=0 fit; apply offsets +/-0.11 dex at z~.95 ONLY as fixed illustrative sensitivity bracket, NOT a calibrated z~.95 one-sigma interval, HOD prior, measurement or independent halo-to-halo posterior.

halo_background_units.H_DM14_z_km_s_Mpc: 100 h_DM14 sqrt[Omega_m_DM14(1+z)^3+OmegaLambda_DM14], neglect radiation only inside this conditional DM14 halo-radius snapshot calculation, NOT a CLASS background calculation.
halo_background_units.original_CLASS_physical_comoving_k_invMp: k_original_h_per_Mpc * original_CLASS_h; mixing original CLASS physical k with DM14 halo r_s is a TAGGED cross-cosmology conditional sensitivity only, never physically self-consistent galaxy source.
halo_background_units.conditional_Fourier_dimensionless_x: x_i=(k_original_h_per_Mpc*original_CLASS_h)*(1+z)*r_s_physical_Mpc. Same E16 original numerical k labels, with h conversion explicit; do not silently identify h_DM14 with h_CLASS.
halo_background_units.conditional_NFW_spatial_u: Use EXACT original E17D2a truncated positive NFW analytic Si/Ci formula u(x,c), same virial truncation and mass normalization. Both original short legs and long K, no multiplication into B.
halo_background_units.static_dimensionful_scale_only: GM200_physical/r_s_physical in (km/s)^2, ONLY a conditional static single-halo potential scale; no source time evolution or neutrino force convolution.

scientific_nonidentifiability.no_individual_halo_assembly_from_populat: Knowing the population median c200c(M,z) for fixed masses at z=.945,.95,.955 gives distinct ensembles at each redshift, not an individual halo trajectory M(a) or dPhi/deta. Concentration scatter and individual mergers remain unobserved.
scientific_nonidentifiability.no_physical_FD_plus_minus_halo_predictio: DM14 calibration is DM-only Planck2013, whereas the original CLASS neutrino deformation uses slightly different Planck cosmology and massive neutrinos. Do not stitch conditional halo u(x,c) to frozen E17D0/E17D1 susceptibility or infer tracer bias from this exercise.
scientific_nonidentifiability.no_real_eBOSS_halo_mass_selection: The two mass anchors are a published pivot and one decade comparison for reproducible evaluations only; not a measurement or HOD for LRG/ELG.

archive_and_governance.original: 18 full source-only conditional DM14 mass-concentration+200c radius NFW spatial reports for every original E16 k1,k2,K; one original joint with QA and max conditional point-mass suppression. No individual halo time history or cosmology-consistent CLASS cross kernel.
archive_and_governance.independent: Separate stdlib scalar DM14 fitting and critical density re-derivation, full 31104 original Fourier shapes using numerical positive NFW 4096-panel Simpson, immutable SHA report and tamper negative control. Archive full original and independent bytes and manifest on audit branch.
